'''Ree Ohr''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-affiliated [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xenobiology|xenobiotics]] specialist active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="medstar" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">The events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which references Ree Ohr, are dated to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> they were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], the site of a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Ohr was responsible for coining the term "[[orthostatic hypotensive syncope of idiopathic origin]]" to describe an unusual malady that struck Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[CT-914]] during the battle; the condition caused him to faint every time he tried to stand up due to low [[Blood/Legends|blood]] pressure. Neither Ohr nor the rest of the Republic medical staff, however, could find a cause of the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] illness. CT-914 was hospitalized in the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]], where he was eventually [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="medstar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ree Ohr was mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="medstar" />
